test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'infrastructure.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence "***It is a national program designed to facilitate investment, foster innovation, enhance skill development and build best-in-class manufacturing ___(5)___***'' is indicating to develop or to manufacture something.
 
• The use of the word ''manufacturing'' in the sentence indicates **making something in large quantities using machines**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'infrastructure'.
 
• The word 'infrastructure' means **the basic systems and services that are necessary for a country or an organization**.&a
